many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import os,glob,re,json
def load():

    return G

def f(inp):
    import collections
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bgc=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find pattern line & separator line
    if any(all(c==inp[r][0] for c in row) for row in inp) or True:
        pass
    axis=None;axisi=None;sepc=None
    # scan uniform full rows/cols whose color != most common bg
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=bgc: axis='row';axisi=r;break
    if axis is None:
        for c in range(w):
            col={inp[r][c] for r in range(h)}
            if len(col)==1 and list(col)[0]!=bgc: axis='col';axisi=c;break
    sepc=list({inp[r][axisi] for r in range(h)})[0] if axis=='col' else list({inp[axisi][c] for c in range(w)})[0]
    # pattern line: perpendicular line through separator
    pat=[inp[c][0] for c in range(w)] if axis=='col' else [inp[r][0] for r in range(h)]
    # cycle: forward if sepc not in pat else reversed
    cycle = pat if sepc not in pat else pat[::-1]
    if axis=='col':
        out=[row[:] for row in inp]
        dirs='R'
        start=(axisi+1, 0) if False else (0, axisi+1)
        # anchor: element adjacent to sep on the far side... 
        # from hypothesis: adjacent fill cell = pattern's LAST element when reversed (sep in P) else FIRST
        anchor_idx = len(cycle)-1 if sepc in pat else 0
        i,j=start
        # which direction along pattern? In demo4 fill proceeds rightward with rev cycle: positions j-axisi+1.. : cycle[k] where k increments
        # anchor element sits just right of separator; moving away, continue cycle forward
        out[i][j]=cycle[anchor_idx]
        k=anchor_idx+1
        for jj in range(j+1,w):
            out[i][j]=cycle[k%len(cycle)]; k+=1; jj+=1; break
        return out
    return None

def solve(inp):

    # horizontal separator
    if any(len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=bg for r in range(h)):
        return solve_rowsep(inp)
    return solve_colsep(inp)
def solve_colsep(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    axi=[c for c in range(w) if {inp[r][c] for r in range(h)}=={inp[0][c]} and inp[0][c]!=bg][0]
    sepc=inp[0][axi]
    pc=[c for c in range(w) if c!=axi and {inp[r][c] for r in range(h)}!=set()][0]  # distinct-col
    # need: full column with h distinct values (all different)
    pc=[c for c in range(w) if c!=axi and len({inp[r][c] for r in range(h)})==h][0]
    pat=[int(inp[r][pc]) for r in range(h)]
    anchor=(len(pat)-1 if sepc in pat else 0)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    step=-1 if pc>axi else +1
    rng=range((axi-step),(w*step)+(-step),step) if False else None
    rng=range(axi-step,-1,step) if pc>axi else range(axi+1,w)
    for d,c in enumerate(rng):
        for r in range(h):
            if inp[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=pat[(anchor-d)%len(pat)]
    return out

        d=[-1]*(h+w)
        out=[row[:] for row in inp]
        for c,r in enumerate(rng): d[r]=c;

        kind='col'; axi=[c for c in range(w) if len({inp[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][c]!=bg][0]; sepc=inp[0][axi]

        out=[row[:] for row in inp]
        a = (len(pat)-1 if sepc in pat else 0)
        for off,c in enumerate(rng):
            for r in range(h):

import collections
def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # row separator
    sepr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=bg]
    if sepr:
        axi=sepr[0]
        pa=[rr for rr in range(h) if rr!=axi and len({x for x in inp[rr]})==w][0]
        pat=[int(inp[pa][c]) for c in range(w)]
        s=inp[axi][0]
        rng=range(axi-1,-1,-1)
        for r in rng:
            d_=abs(r-axi)
            for c in range(w):
                if inp[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=pat[(pat.index(s,d_) if False else -d_+len(pat))%(len(pat))]
        return out
    # col separator
    sepc=[c for c in range(w) if len({inp[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][c]!=bg]
    axi=sepc[0]
    pa=[cc for cc in range(w) if cc!=axi and len({inp[r][cc] for r in range(h)})==h][0]
    pat=[int(inp[r][pa]) for r in range(h)]
    s=inp[0][axi]
    for c in range(w):
        if c==axi or c==pa: continue
        d_=abs(c-axi)
        for r in range(h):
            if inp[r][c]== bg: out[r][c]=pat[(pat.index(s,d_) if False else -d_+len(pat))%(len(pat))]
    return out
for k in range(1,6):
    print(k, solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair 5' if k==5 else 'Demo pair %d output'%k])
